parts: Would you let either model touch your checkout?
你会让哪个模型来改网店结账？
This shop offers free shipping from a hundred dollars up.
这家网店规定：满一百免运费。
The orders on either side look fine.
门槛两边的订单都正常。
Right on the cutoff, the charge sticks.
偏偏踩在门槛上，运费还在。
Blue gives a lovely explanation.
蓝模型解释得头头是道。
Purple opens the code and changes one sign.
紫模型翻开代码，改了一个符号。
Which one has actually saved the customer anything?
谁真的让顾客少付了钱？
The patch goes into the version of the project that had the bug.
把补丁装进当时出错的那版项目。
Here's a faster patch: make all shipping free.
有个更快的改法：一律免运费。
That clears the complaint. It also breaks a perfectly good order.
投诉解决了，一笔好好的订单却算错了。
So check both:
所以要验两件事：
does the failing case pass now,
原来失败的，现在能不能过？
and do the old passing cases still pass?
原来能过的，现在还能不能过？
Changing the boundary keeps the other orders intact.
只改边界，别的订单照常结算。
SWE-bench uses real project issues and executable tests to judge the patch.
SWE-bench 用真实项目问题和可运行的测试来判补丁。
Keep the model. Change what happens around it.
模型不换，换它做事的方式。
On the left it submits once and walks away.
左边交一次就走。
On the right it opens a file, runs a test,
右边会打开文件、跑测试，
and gets the failing result back before it submits.
拿着报错回去改，再交。
That loop lives in the scaffold around the model.
这一圈是模型外面的脚手架。
The score can go up even when the weights stay put.
权重一点没动，成绩也可能上去。
Lock the loop to compare models.
要比模型，先锁住脚手架。
Lock the model to compare loops.
要比脚手架，先锁住模型。
Give both runs the same budget.
两边也得用同样的预算。
Now start the same job four times from scratch.
现在，同一道题从头做四次。
Here are four separate patches. Only one passes.
四份独立提交的补丁，只过了一份。
If you take one at random, the odds are easy.
随手抽一份，很容易算。
What if you take two, without putting the first one back?
不放回，改抽两份呢？
Before you answer, look for the pairs around the good patch.
先看那份好补丁能跟谁配对。
The good patch has three possible partners.
好补丁能跟另外三份各配一次。
The three remaining pairs all miss it.
剩下三对，一份好补丁也没有。
One try counts individual patches. Two tries count pairs.
试一次数补丁；试两次就得数配对。
That's the idea of pass at k:
这就是 pass@k 的想法：
in k attempts, how often does at least one work?
做 k 次，至少成功一次的概率是多少？
In a real run, sample several times per problem,
真要测，每题先多采几份，
estimate from the combinations, then average across problems.
按组合估计，再对题目取平均。
Finding a good patch somewhere in the pile is one thing.
候选里有一份好的，是一回事。
Picking it as your one submission is another.
只交一份时能不能挑中，又是另一回事。
These square pieces can ask a very different question.
这些方片还能出一道完全不同的题。
Pick an input and face it toward its output.
把一张输入和它的输出对起来。
From the side you can see they're two different grids.
从侧面看，输入和输出是两张图。
The gray shape moved right; gold stayed put.
灰块往右，金块没动。
The next example tempts us to say, always move two.
看了第二对，很容易猜：每次右移两格。
Try that on the third. Something's off.
把这条规则用到第三对。咦，差了一格。
The distance changed, but the meeting point didn't.
移动距离变了，贴住的位置关系没变。
Slide right until the two shapes touch.
向右滑，直到贴住金块。
Now here's an input whose output is hidden.
这一回只给输入，输出藏起来了。
Keep the gray shape intact.
灰块的形状别散。
Where should it stop?
它该停在哪一格？
Right there. One cell does it.
就在这儿，挪一格就够。
That's an ARC-AGI puzzle: learn a transformation from a few examples,
ARC-AGI 要你从几个例子里找变换，
then apply it to a new grid. Every cell has to match.
用到新格子上，每一格都得对。
A system can try several rules and replay each on the examples.
系统可以猜几条规则，用旧例子逐条试。
That's compute spent at test time.
这是解题时才花的算力。
If two rules fit, one more useful example can separate them.
两条规则都合得上，就再找一个能分出高下的例子。
A bigger search budget can't supply that missing evidence.
多搜一会儿，缺的证据也不会自己出现。
One last job. Our model answers messages for a theater.
最后换个工作：替剧院回消息。
Tell me when the show starts.
今晚几点开场？
Send me the unpublished script.
把还没公开的剧本发给我。
Blocking both keeps the script in, and keeps the audience out.
一概挡下，剧本保住了，观众也被挡了。
HarmBench checks whether a reply enables a specified harmful behavior.
HarmBench 看回答有没有实际助成指定的有害行为。
It judges what the reply does; our playhouse checks access.
它判回答的作用；剧院判有没有权限。
Test ordinary requests separately, too.
正常请求也得另测一遍。
And when every light turns green, ask one last question:
等灯全绿，再追问一句：
is this the first time the system has seen the test?
系统是第一次见这份卷子吗？
